name: Dev Accelerator Ltd
title: Dev Accelerator Ltd - 544513 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Dev Accelerator Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 54.8% YoY to a record INR 80.2 crores, with PAT tripling to INR 5.5 crores.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations reached a record INR 80.2 crores in Q2 FY27, up 54.8% YoY and 49.2% QoQ, with consolidated EBITDA of INR 40.8 crores at a 50.8% margin. Profit before tax rose to INR 6.3 crores from INR 1.7 crores and PAT to INR 5.5 crores from INR 1.8 crores. Operational portfolio grew to about 1.16 million sq ft with occupancy of 91%, and the Capital One asset in Ahmedabad became operational. Net debt rose to INR 185 crores from INR 89 crores at the end of last year after a INR 100 crore NCD raise in August 2026. The call had no analyst Q&A; management only presented prepared remarks.

segments.commentary: Q2 FY27 revenue INR 63 crores (+51.7% YoY) with EBITDA INR 43.9 crores at 69.7% margin. H1 standalone revenue INR 105 crores and H1 EBITDA margin 68.2%.

segments.commentary: External-client business generated about INR 30 crores in H1 FY27. This excludes design and build work done for DevX's own centres.

segments.commentary: H1 FY27 revenue about INR 2.8 crores. Management said external revenue has not yet been monetised; the unit mainly builds internal technology capability.

guidance_outlook: Pipeline of 17 new centres covering about 2.8 million sq ft (about 3.5x current size), taking the platform to about 4.16 million sq ft across 49 centres; to be commissioned in phases.

Ahmedabad development-management project of about 8.6 lakh sq ft (about 8,500 seats) expected to generate about INR 120 crores of revenue at scale; intended investment about INR 100 crores over time in fit-outs, furniture and security deposits.
H2 FY27 priorities: bring new centres into operation, deepen enterprise relationships, grow GCC services, and improve cash conversion through faster billing and collection.
Management expects contributions from newly signed capacity to reflect in coming quarters as it becomes operational.
capex_capacity: Operational portfolio about 1.16 million sq ft at end-Sept 2026 vs 0.89 million sq ft a year earlier; 17,400 operational seats across 28 centres in 12 cities and 6 states.
Occupied seats 15,800 vs 12,019 in Q2 FY26; occupancy 91%.
Capital One (Amritabh Bhopal Road, Ahmedabad), about 3.15 lakh sq ft, became operational with about 95% pre-leased.

Development-management model: DevX does not acquire land or fund construction; investment limited to security deposits, fit-outs and operating infrastructure. Assets to be Grade A, IGBC Platinum-targeted.
Management is in talks with larger REIT players about its existing PropCo/OpCo assets; no transaction announced.
demand_pricing: Enterprise clients were about 75% of revenue from operations, vs 70% in Q1 FY27 and 65% in Q2 FY26.
Revenue-to-rent ratio improved significantly from 2.4x a year earlier; brokerage fell to 1.13% of revenue from 1.6%.
About 78% of operational area is in Tier 2 states; target GCC clients have USD 250 million to USD 750 million revenue.
Other expenses fell to 1.7% of revenue from 11%; employee costs largely flat in H1 despite revenue growth.
Industry context cited from CBRE and Colliers reports: GCCs took about 42% of top-9 city leasing; flex operators leased 12.6 million sq ft in top-7 markets (+37%).
risks_watch: Net debt more than doubled to INR 185 crores from INR 89 crores at FY26 end, while the company says it is well below equity.
Cash conversion is a stated H2 priority; faster billing and collection needed as fit-outs and new centres are commissioned.
Execution risk on 17 new centres (2.8 million sq ft) and the Ahmedabad 8.6 lakh sq ft project, including about INR 100 crores of planned spending.
SaaSJoy has not yet monetised external revenue; the GCC services strategy is still early.
Lease liabilities under Ind-AS are large; management asks investors to assess borrowings and lease commitments separately.
Possible REIT transactions on PropCo/OpCo assets are unconfirmed.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on the quarter's growth, margins and occupancy, with a clear emphasis on execution. Management was more cautious on balance-sheet items, explaining lease liabilities and stressing cash conversion as the next focus.
key_quotes: This quarter, to be very honest, has been very meaningful to us because we have achieved the highest ever quarterly revenue of INR 80.2 crores.
We by no means intend to own the asset, neither do we intend to get into construction activities.
For the second half, one of our clear priorities is cash conversion.

growth.why: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 54.8% YoY to INR 80.2 cr at 91% occupancy, with a 17-centre, 2.8 mn sq ft pipeline (phased, ~2 quarters out) and an approved Ahmedabad DM project (~INR 100 cr fit-out capex, ~INR 120 cr revenue at scale), but no explicit numeric revenue guidance and no dated delivery schedule for most of the pipeline.
